title: Number ring
description: A thin gold ring draws up to a share of the circle (Motion animates the stroke) while the number in the middle counts with it; the meaning stands beside it.

props.value: required, 0-100: how much of the ring fills
props.show: the number in the middle if it is not the percent (for example 5)
props.label: what the number means, 3-8 words

example.label: A free live class, Monday to Friday
example.text: Every weeknight at 8 PM. Theory and practice, for beginners.
